comment: Search quality smoke for the real model and the pinned corpus. The best passage must come from one of 'paths' (int8 kernels differ a little between CPUs, so a question that two docs answer lists both). Off-topic questions must find nothing. tests/test_quality.py and scripts/smoke_check.py read this file.

answered.question: Which embedding model does the mascot use?
Which email provider sends the invites?
What colours does the design system use?
